title: DevProof bundle config blob, format v1
description: The exact inventory of what a bundle contains, stored as the OCI config blob with media type application/vnd.thingz.devproof.config.v1+json and encoded with RFC 8785 JSON canonicalization. It exists so verification never has to trust tar extraction behavior: a consumer checks every entry against this list before writing anything. The document deliberately has nowhere to put a bundle name, source, timestamp, builder, registry reference, tag, annotation, or signature -- admitting any of them would make two builds of identical content produce different subject digests (DP-002).

treeDigest.description: SHA-256 over the domain-separated binary tree-record stream defined in docs/bundle-format.md. Independent of tar and gzip encoding, so it is a stable logical payload identity while the OCI manifest digest identifies the exact encoded artifact.

fileCount.description: Must equal the length of files.

totalSize.description: Must equal the sum of every entry's size.

files.description: Sorted by canonical UTF-8 path bytes, strictly increasing. Parent directories are derived from these paths and are not entries here. May be empty: format v1 encodes the record count as an integer that may be zero, so an empty tree is representable. A manifest cannot produce one -- composition rejects an empty selection -- but that is a manifest rule, not a format rule.

path.description: Canonical relative path: valid UTF-8, NFC-normalized, slash-separated, with no "." or ".." segments and no path aliases.

mode.description: Normalized file mode, decimal: 420 is 0644 and 493 is 0755.

digest.description: SHA-256 over the exact file bytes.
